column1: # Toshiba runtime routines that V4.23 calls by their library names, and the trees' labels for them; read by
# scripts/build/cc900_firmware_c.py runtime_names() (with results/pairs.tsv's our_label for the matched C library).
# tree: a shell pattern matched against the tree's path (*/maincpu, hdae5000*, v142/subcpu); the most specific
# pattern wins.  name: as the listing writes it.
# Main CPU (coordinator / lane_vmb, 2026-11-16): the assembly library's LMULL.ASM (C9H_mullu and C9H_mulls are one
# entry) and LDIVL.ASM, whose entries sit in the ROM in the library's order: remls, divls (SDivMod), remlu, divlu at
# Math_RemainderSigned32, Math_DivideSigned32, Math_RemainderU32, Math_DivideU32 (0xff0c0a, 0c0e, 0c12, 0c18 in v10).
# Sub-CPU: lane_sub, each confirmed by matches (Long_SignedDiv / Long_SignedRem: its renames, branch cc900/c-subcpu-hdae).
